verdict.rationale: Onboarding speed is a fair question for a business banking and spend platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no first-party claim that a founder can fully onboard in about a week. The Onboarding API only covers referrals and prefilling signup data, which is adjacent rather than a time-to-onboard capability, and community reports describe a long, painful signup and rejected applications rather than fast onboarding.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
